item.title: Barnacle 0.2.3
item.description:
### Fixed
- The in-app website and licence links now open the Barnacle page at
  getflanders.com/barnacle.

item.title: Barnacle 0.2.2
item.description:
### Fixed
- **Barnacle Disk now shows your files.** Mounting a server in Finder could
  leave an empty drive that also refused new files. Two things are fixed: the
  mounted extension can now read the credentials it needs (so servers with a
  passphrase-protected key connect), and it correctly maps the server's home
  directory as the root of the mount, so files and folders appear and creating
  them in Finder sends them to the server. Existing mounts heal themselves on
  the next launch.

item.title: Barnacle 0.2.1
item.description:
### Added
- **Deploy straight from a folder.** Right-click any folder while browsing and
  choose Add Deploy Target Here — the deploy path is filled in for you.

### Improved
- **One-click GitHub sign-in.** Connecting a repository now opens GitHub in your
  browser to authorise and you're done, with a short guided setup the first
  time.
- **A clearer deploy screen.** Deploying now shows the commit range and the
  commits included, colour-coded file changes with add/change/remove counts,
  and — while it runs — a live step-by-step view (commands, upload progress,
  config files) with the server's command output and a plain success or
  failure result.
